read.thesis: Record Q3 adj EPS $2.13 on 2% organic growth, but FY25 guide cut to $7.60–7.70 on refinish destocking; aerospace capex >$0.5bn peaks 2026–27 with normalisation expected mid-2026.

capex.quote: These investments represent more than $0.5 billion and are being completed in order to capitalize on the significant multiyear growth opportunity we have in this business.

triggers.label: Refinish distributor destocking into year-end
triggers.quote: We expect a year-over-year decline in organic sales similar to that in the third quarter as distributors have been managing their inventories heading into year-end.

triggers.label: Insurance claims still negative
triggers.quote: Claims in the beginning of the year were down high single digits, in some cases, low double digits. Our latest claims data was down mid-single digits.

triggers.label: Aerospace capex >$0.5bn, peaks 2026–27
triggers.quote: These investments represent more than $0.5 billion and are being completed in order to capitalize on the significant multiyear growth opportunity

triggers.label: Architectural EMEA price up 36 quarters
triggers.quote: price increases have been maintained for 36 consecutive quarters.

triggers.label: Industrial coatings volume +4%, auto OEM +8%
triggers.quote: Third quarter sales volumes increased 4%, outpacing industry demand as we realized the run rate benefit of share gains

guidance.quote: we have updated our full year guidance of adjusted earnings per diluted share to a range of $7.60 to $7.70.

guidance.metric: Full-year low single-digit raw material inflation
guidance.quote: we are expecting low single-digit inflation for the year

red_flags.label: Refinish distributor destocking extended
red_flags.quote: the normalization of claims did not happen as early as expected. And so that's driven destocking further than what we expected

red_flags.label: 2026 first half softer
red_flags.quote: 2006 (sic) [ 2026 ] looks softer in the first half than what we envisioned earlier this year.

evasions.quote: So am I surprised that one particular competitor gained share -- announced gain share? Absolutely not.
